intro: The **User Auth initializer** configures authentication and authorization features including login, registration, password management, and session handling. Use initialization to customize authentication flows and user data models.

authHeaderConfig.description: Configures authentication header format for API requests including custom header names and token prefix format (for example, 'Bearer', 'Token').

customerPermissionRoles.description: Fetches and caches customer role-based permissions during initialization and on authentication state changes when set to `true`. Useful for B2B feature gating.

subsection.title: customerPermissionRoles

CustomerModel.description: Transforms customer authentication data including profile information, addresses, and account settings. Use this to add custom fields or modify user data structures.
